**Finding: deviation (LICENSE — licence grant scope)**

- **Issue:** Section 2(a) licenses only "Client" — no affiliates, no contractors acting on our behalf — and Section 2(b) scope adds only multi-site access, so there is no mechanism to extend use to group companies or outsourced providers. This falls below the fallback (affiliates on written notice). Section 15 also allows transfer only to a financially responsible affiliate, not to a successor in an M&A transaction.
- **Not an issue:** The licence is not revocable at will; it runs until the Agreement terminates (2(c)), with the Section 13 cut-off tied to uncured breaches.
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** adds "its affiliates and its contractors acting on Client's behalf" to the grant, and adds successor-in-interest transfer to the assignment clause (symmetric, so no downside to us). Fallback of affiliate coverage on written notice offered in the comment.
